- **Stage**: 3 (P0 code), Windows QA follow-up 2026-10-28 (Claude Opus 5.5 agent owning generators / models / voice / music / captions generation, Timeline playhead and item-menu clipboard; two other agents worked in parallel: (A) agent runtime + chat, (M) auto motion — their files were not edited except the small, self-contained `itemsEdit paste` branch in `packages/agents/src/intents.ts` and one line in `services/egress.ts` / `context.ts` (new purpose / optional hooks)). QA items: downloads EM-7002 (whisper large-v3-turbo, large-v3, Kokoro), #5 Copy/Cut/Paste, #6 playhead, #7 voice and captions not in sync, #8 one voice / no narrator choice, #9 / #10 music "model tidak tersedia", #11 "energi besi"; plus the coordinator's acceptance prompt "Ekspor Nikel" (9 voice clips with measured durations, voice by description, gaps, speed-up, captions = written text) and the "SRT-style transcript, always in sync" requirement.
- **Root causes (evidence)**:
  1. Downloads: the QA log has three `model download failed` lines 3–4 s apart with `err: "Download of … failed"` — that message is only produced for the RETRYABLE class (network error, 429 / 5xx, bad Content-Range, broken stream) after 3 quick attempts (1 s + 2 s backoff); the cause (status / network code) was dropped. Reproduced the full code path here with the real Hugging Face chain (302 → `us.aws.cdn.hf.co` Xet bridge, allow-listed by `*.hf.co`): Kokoro `model.onnx` 325 MB in 27.8 s, sha256 = pin, so the download code itself works on a good network. On the QA network every attempt failed fast; candidates the new logging will name: HF anonymous rate limit (`RateLimit "resolvers";q=3000;w=300` per IP — shared CGNAT IPs in Indonesia), a dropped / filtered connection, a TLS interception (antivirus HTTPS scanning, ISP filter). The exact cause on the QA PC is NOT proven (not reproducible here).
  2. Music: `ace-step-v1-3.5b` and `loop-library-cc0` had `files: []` → not pinned → EM-7110 "Model not available yet" for both (screenshots p5).
  3. Voice: one catalogue entry per language; plan args `voice` (alias of `voiceId`) carried descriptions → `requireInstalled(<description>)` → EM-7001 (log lines 24, 103) although Piper id was installed.
  4. Captions: `captions.generate` on the Sequence transcribes the voice with whisper and uses its TEXT ("besi"); the plan path spread script words proportionally over the layer (not in sync).
  5. Playhead: only the ruler handled pointer events and it scrolled away with the lanes; no clipboard.
- **Fixes**: FR-245 (download.ts: progress-aware retries, backoff + jitter, Retry-After / HF `RateLimit t=`, stall 60 s / headers 45 s watchdogs, `.part` hashed before Range resume, `classifyNetError` reasons; models-service logs reason / status / netCode / host / attempts and emits `retry`; Model Manager shows "Mencoba lagi: <alasan> — n dtk" and reason-specific Indonesian advice, Lanjutkan resumes failed downloads). FR-246 (`voices.ts` catalogue: local Piper id + ±2-semitone variants named as variants, Piper en, Kokoro; OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts 13 voices, Gemini gemini-3.8-flash-tts 30 voices, ElevenLabs account voices with its own sealed key; `voices-service.ts` with the `tts` egress purpose, SEC-135; picker UI with description search, filters, previews, install / connect / Private Mode reasons, cost estimate, style, speed). FR-247 (`music-library.ts`: 28 CC0 tracks pinned per file at a fixed commit of the HF FreePD mirror, licence proof; `music-library-service.ts`; library UI with moods, preview, download, "Pakai sebagai musik"; ACE-Step → `evaluate`, explained). FR-251 (`voiceBatch`: R-138 + `ctx.hooks.voiceBatch`, clip assets `v1.wav …`, gaps 0.3 / 0.5 s by scene, speed-up ≤ 1.2× instead of cutting, all-or-nothing). FR-252 (EM-7001 holds the plan steps; sticky toast "Pasang"; `model.installed` resumes them). FR-253 … FR-256 (Timeline single scroll container, sticky ruler, draggable playhead slider over the whole height, press-to-seek on empty space, Alt+click seeks, ←/→/Shift/Home/End; Copy / Cut / Paste via an in-app snapshot clipboard and ONE `itemsEdit {action: 'paste'}` pick).
- **For the agent runtime (A) and auto motion (M)** — API to call: `ctx.hooks.voiceBatch(projectId, {clips: [{id: 'v1', text: <spoken, numbers as words>, written?: <display>}], voiceId: <id or description, e.g. "natural, hangat, jelas, percaya diri">, language: 'id', speed?, style?: 'tempo sedang cenderung cepat', maxTotalMs?: 60000, scenes?: [['v1','v2'],['v3'],…], gapMs?: 300, sceneGapMs?: 500, startMs?: 0, captions?: true, insert?: true})` → `{jobId, speed, regenerated, totalMs, overLimit, clips: [{id, assetId, name, durationMs, atMs, endMs, scene, timing, cues: [{index, text, written, fromMs, toMs, words: [{text, fromMs, toMs}]}]}]}` (cue / word times relative to the clip start; AssetFacts.durationMs is set by ingest); rejects with the EM code and places nothing. `ctx.hooks.voiceCatalog('id')` (voice rows with availability, for "pick a voice by description" in the agent context) and `ctx.hooks.voiceTranscript(assetId)`. Suggested optional anchor for the VideoSpec (M owns it): `at: {clip: 'v2', cue?: number, word?: number | string, edge: 'start' | 'end', pct?, offsetMs?}` → time = clip.atMs + cue/word fromMs (or toMs). Plan-card change for A: on `service.notice {kind: 'plan-step', status: 'needs-model', modelKey}` show "Pasang model" on the step (the Editor already shows a sticky toast with the action) and "Melanjutkan…" on `status: 'resumed'`; the tts.generate tool schema may add `clips[]` later (today: one text per step; batches through the hook).

## 2026-10-27 — Entry 30: Claude in the chat — no crash on open, native tool calling + markup fallback, streaming, unmistakable progress, image attachments, onboarding models (FR-210 … FR-215, ADR-032)

- **Stage**: 3 (P0 code), Windows QA follow-up (Claude Opus 5.5 agent; owner of chat / agents / providers; the Entry 29 agent worked in parallel on startup / project open, fonts, export, desktop — FR-202…FR-205 are theirs, FR-206…FR-209 left free). **QA** (Windows 11, T0, Claude Sonnet 5.5 on a direct Anthropic key, logs `shell-2026-10-27.log` / `service-2026-10-27.log`): no exported video; the right column crashed on every open; raw `<invoke>` blocks in Diskusi answers; image attach → EM-9002; "agent brainstorming tidak memberitahu… dikira error"; onboarding "Choose your models" showed "No model list yet / 0 of 0"; an `sk-ant-` key chosen as OpenAI → EM-4002.
- **Root causes (with evidence)**:
  1. Crash: run `01M5Y4763P…` (07:29:59, `proposals: 1, targets: 1`) stored a proposed intent without `params`; `BrainstormTurn.proposedIntents[].params` was optional, the run stored it as is, and `intentTitle` (`proposals.tsx`) read `i.params['__output']` → the TypeError at 07:29:59.743 and on every later open (07:31, 07:32, 07:33, 07:35, 07:36; component stack in `aside` = chat). The stored message kept crashing because nothing normalised it at read time.
  2. Raw markup: the Brainstorm tool protocol was JSON in plain text (`{"tool","input"}`); Claude answered in its own markup (screenshots p2_X11 / p3_X14). Runs 2–3 logged `toolCalls: 0` / `2` with such text: the JSON parser did not see a call, the markup became the reply.
  3. Image attach: the composer sent `multipart/form-data` (`uploadAssets` with FormData); R-030 refuses multipart with EM-9002 on every build (the packaged Editor never used the Shell path in the chat). Next in line: direct Anthropic rows had `imageInput: null` (the adapter ignored the Models API `capabilities`), so the Service would have refused with EM-4307; and the direct adapters dropped image parts.
  4. Looked like an error: the direct adapters did not stream (one 33 s silent request; 120 s cap ahead for Editor runs) and between Send and the 202 there was no working state; Brainstorm phases read "Menyusun rencana…".
  5. Onboarding: **not reproduced** — `E2E_REPRO_ONBOARDING=1 poc/e2e/claude-flow.mjs` with the QA's exact sequence against a build of 52658a0 (= the QA installer, built 11:48) shows 13 rows. Found on that path and fixed: the refused OpenAI connection stays the default connection; the model form only auto-fetched for a `valid` connection with no loading state for the cache read; "Use defaults" only moved on (no assignment stored); the old default resolved to the most expensive model (Claude Fable 5.1); no hint that the key belongs to another provider.
- **Fixes**:
  - FR-212: `ProposedIntent` (params default {}), `normalizeProposedIntents` (categories mapped, bad preset ids / targets dropped, empty items dropped) before storing; `normalizeMessageBlocks` / `normalizeStoredProposal` (packages/shared) at every read: Service R-080 / R-081 / `agent.run.done` / handoff / history, Editor reducer (`messages`, `messageAdded`, `agent.run.done`, `queue`); guarded `params` reads in `intentTitle`, Intent Queue, Assistant chat, `targetText`, store.

Editor and Brainstorm loops share `runToolCalls`.
  - FR-210: SSE streaming in the Anthropic, OpenAI and Gemini adapters (event shapes per each provider's docs; mid-stream `error` → EM code; JSON fallback when a proxy does not stream); 16 000-token streamed output floor (OpenAI: reasoning models only) with a once-per-model retry at the caller's budget when a model refuses it.
  - FR-213: composer imports through the Shell picker / dropped path (R-030 paths) or a raw body in browser development (CORS now allows `X-Expertmotion-Filename`); chip with spinner, Send waits for ready; Service waits ≤ 20 s for ingest (EM-4308), a failed import answers with its code; image parts per provider; Anthropic Models API `capabilities.image_input` / `structured_outputs` / `max_input_tokens` read (all pages); `imageInput: false` → the message goes with the file name (EM-4307 note, attachment `sent: name`); unknown → tried, a refusal naming the image → re-run with names only and the cached row learns `false`; the history names attachments.

## 2026-10-27 — Entry 29: the real packaged app, end to end — Start screen + crash-loop guard + safe open, fonts under app://, low memory never blocks an export, Windows output folders (FR-202 … FR-205)

- **Stage**: 3 (P0 code), Windows QA follow-up (Claude Opus 5.5 agent; owner of startup / export / fonts / packaging e2e; another agent worked on chat / agents / providers at the same time and fixes the `__output` crash). **QA 2026-10-27** (Windows 11, 8 GB, T0; logs `~/expertmotion-feedback/`): not a single video could be exported; #2 the previous project failed to load after install; #6 after the error the app could not be opened at all, Reload did not help; #7 after close + reopen it read the old project again; the renderer log had `TypeError: Failed to fetch at fetchFontData` (unhandled rejection) on every Editor mount and the Service logged `engine warm-up skipped: low memory` with freeMb 535–1087.
- **Root causes (each proven, not guessed)**: (1) **Fonts**: the packaged Editor's CSP `connect-src http://127.0.0.1:*` blocks `fetch(app://expertmotion/fonts/…)`; `@remotion/fonts` `loadFont` fetches, then `cancelRender` → unhandled rejection. Proven in the real packaged Electron (old build, CDP): `fetch('app://expertmotion/fonts/inter-latin-400-normal.woff2')` → "Failed to fetch", `new FontFace(..., 'url(app://…)').load()` → loaded. The protocol handler, MIME (`font/woff2`) and the privileged scheme (`supportFetchAPI`) were fine. (2) **No export possible**: the export preflight required 2 GB free memory (EM-3101) and disabled Start; the T0 laptop had 0.5–1.1 GB available. (3) **Crash loop**: boot always reopened `recentProjects()[0]`; a project whose view crashes reopened on every launch and every Reload, and the crash card only offered Reload.
- **Fixes**:
  - FR-203 `packages/engine/src/fonts.ts`: FontFace `url()` sources (`font-src 'self'`), 15 s timeout per face, failures counted and reported once (`[em] EM-8014 …` console warning, fallback font), always resolves, always releases the delayRender handle; no `@remotion/fonts` import any more (the dependency stays in package.json, unused). CSP `media-src` gained `data:` (the Player's shared audio tags start from a silent data: clip; the packaged run logged a CSP violation on every play) — SEC-024 updated; `connect-src` unchanged.
  - FR-202 `apps/ui/src/startup/session-guard.ts` + `screens/StartScreen.tsx`: every launch shows the Start screen (`scr.start`: Recent projects with "Mode aman", "Proyek baru", "Buka…"); an in-window Reload reopens the open project (sessionStorage); the guard counts a top-level crash within 60 s after opening, or an open that never settled (renderer died / app killed; a normal `pagehide` settles it); 2 crashes / 30 min block auto-open with `scr.start.notice` "Proyek terakhir gagal dibuka" → "Buka dalam mode aman" / "Proyek baru"; safe open renders neither the chat thread nor the live preview (`sys.safe.*`, one click each) until asked; the crash card `sys.crash` has Muat ulang / Buka proyek lain / Proyek baru / Buka folder log (the Shell now sends `logsDir` with every service state). No project open → Start screen, never an empty Editor; the header title is empty then. Mock runtime keeps the auto-open (tests, demo). Store: `noteProjectOpening` in openProject, `bootDecision` in boot, `noteProjectClosed` on `projectClosed` (three small edits).

## 2026-10-27 — Entry 27: the window must never stay black without a way out — GPU crashes, safe graphics mode, crash-loop guard, heartbeat watchdog, escape hatches, native diagnostic report (FR-196 … FR-199)

- **Stage**: 3 (P0 code), Windows QA follow-up (Claude Opus 5.5 agent; apps/desktop owner; another agent worked in apps/ui + apps/service at the same time). **Problem** (Windows 11, 8 GB, ~1 GB-VRAM iGPU, T0): the window goes completely black at startup and again right after connecting the Claude provider; nothing can be clicked, so the in-app Reload / Open log folder (Entry 23) are useless; the old build's logs showed nothing. Diagnosis from the code: nothing in the Shell handled the GPU process (`child-process-gone`), a window that is alive but paints nothing raises no Electron event, `ready-to-show` never fires without a first paint, only `[em]`-tagged console lines were logged, and Ctrl+R was removed (Entry 18). Entry 23 (splash, ErrorBoundary, `render-process-gone` / `unresponsive`) covered only renderer crashes and hangs.
- **Completed (all main-process / native; work with a dead renderer or GPU)**:
  - `lib/graphics-mode.ts` (FR-196, FR-197): GPU `child-process-gone` (not clean-exit) → log EM-8010 + crash file, reload 1.5 s later; 2nd within 10 min → `data/graphics.json` `{mode:'safe', reason:'gpu-crash', since}` + graceful Service stop + relaunch → `app.disableHardwareAcceleration()` before ready; other child types logged; in safe mode a GPU crash only reloads. Clean-shutdown marker `data/session.json` (`running` after the lock; `clean` on every deliberate exit through `exitApp` / `will-quit` / Windows `session-end` / `powerMonitor` shutdown / update install); 2 abnormal ends in a row → safe mode `reason:'crash-loop'`. **Way back (decision)**: safe mode expires after 7 days (next launch tries the GPU; a new crash pair re-enables it), or at once via tray "Mulai ulang dengan akselerasi GPU" / the one-time dialog "Mode grafis aman aktif" (EM-8011) button "Kembali ke mode normal"; `--safe-graphics` forces one launch without persisting.
  - `lib/heartbeat.ts` + preload (FR-198): preload sends `first-paint` (first rAF after DOMContentLoaded), `editor-mounted` (`[data-region="stage"]` exists — no Editor change needed) and every 2 s `{seq, framed, visible}` on private send-only channels `em:heartbeat` / `em:renderer-signal` (not on `window.expertmotion`; sender + payload checked); one rAF per beat, never a continuous loop. 1 s watchdog: no beat > 10 s, beats without frames > 10 s while visible (dead GPU/compositor = black window), or no first paint in 45 s → ONE native dialog "Tampilan tidak merespons" (EM-8012: Muat ulang / Mode grafis aman / Buka folder log / Tunggu / Tutup; Esc = Tunggu; re-ask after 60 s; auto-dismissed on recovery). Hidden / minimized / occluded-and-unfocused time never counts (10 s grace after showing). `recoveryDialog` coordinator: renderer-gone, `unresponsive` and display dialogs never stack. Window shown after 10 s even without a first paint. "Tutup" / tray "Keluar" use `quitGracefully` (Service stop, no `beforeunload` round trip to a hung renderer).
  - Logging (FR-198, FR-196): every renderer console warning / error (string or numeric level, ≤ 30/min with a `dropped` count, query strings / e-mails removed, source + line), `preload-error`, main `unhandledRejection`; `shell start` (version, OS, RAM, switches), `graphics mode`, `previous session did not shut down cleanly`, `gpu info` (feature status + vendor/device/driver from `getGPUInfo('basic')`, 5 s timeout; also `data/gpu-info.json`), `gpu feature status changed` (changes only, ≤ 20), one `startup timings` line (app-ready, window-created/shown, did-finish-load, first-paint, editor-mounted, integrity-done, keyring-done, service-ready; or partial after 90 s).
  - `lib/escape-hatches.ts` + `window-chrome.ts` (FR-199): Ctrl+R / F5 reload (hung renderer killed first, not counted as a crash), Ctrl+Shift+L log folder — read in `before-input-event` (browser process, before the page) + hidden "Pemulihan" menu with the same accelerators; 1 s debounce; checked against `apps/ui/src/shortcuts.ts` (Ctrl+R, F5, Ctrl+Shift+L unused; plain L = play kept). Tray: Tampilkan Expertmotion, Muat ulang tampilan, Mulai ulang dalam mode grafis aman (or the way back), Buka folder log, Simpan laporan diagnostik ke Desktop, Keluar; left click = show.
  - `lib/diagnostic-report.ts` (FR-199, SEC-105): zip of today's + yesterday's shell/service/engine logs (+ `.old`, tails ≤ 8 MB), crash files ≤ 7 days (newest 20), `system.json` (versions, OS, CPU, RAM, engines PLATFORM.json, graphics state, session marker, GPU summary, watchdog facts, timings), `README.txt`; allow-list by file name; every entry re-redacted (SEC-100 + home → `~` + secret JSON fields + 64-hex). Desktop, else logs folder; Explorer opens on it. `Expertmotion.exe --diagnostics` runs before the single-instance lock (works while a black copy runs): no window, no Service, hardware acceleration off, temp userData; writes the zip, reveals it, exits.
  - Installer `apps/desktop/installer/expertmotion.nsi`: Start-menu `Expertmotion – Diagnostik.lnk` (`--diagnostics`, EN/ID description), removed by the uninstaller.
  - apps/ui (tiny wiring, said so): shortcut sheet rows `Ctrl+R / F5` (`ui.key.reload`) and `Ctrl+Shift+L` (`ui.key.logs`) in `screens/Misc.tsx`; two keys inserted in en/id i18n.
  - Docs: FRD FR-196…FR-199 (+ group map, traceability); ERROR_CATALOGUE EM-8010…EM-8013; SECURITY SEC-105 (+ SEC-103 note, summary 100…105); VULNERABILITY_CHECKLIST VC-151; DEPLOYMENT_AND_PACKAGING §5 (shortcuts, state files, switches), §13 (shortcuts removed), §14 (GPU / session / display rows, native report); apps/desktop/README; memory.md.

## 2026-10-26 — Entry 19: QA fixes for Generate Voice / Captions / Thumbnail (QA items 10–14) and engine-failure logging

- **Root cause, Voice (10/11/12)**, reproduced on this server with the official sherpa-onnx **v1.13.8 Linux x64 shared** build (sha256 c0bdb790…15c4 = GitHub release digest), the shipped espeak-ng-data.zip (bc4525ea…), the pinned rhasspy Piper files (hashes = `pins.ts`) and the exact `sherpaTtsArgs` argv: exit **255**, stderr `offline-tts-vits-model.cc:Init:169 'sample_rate' does not exist in the metadata`, the same for id text, en text and en text with the id voice. Raw rhasspy `.onnx` files lack the ONNX metadata sherpa-onnx requires. Fix: `preparePiperVoice` (packages/models/src/install.ts) writes `sherpa-model.onnx` = upstream bytes + appended `metadata_props` (model_type=vits, comment=piper, language, voice=espeak.voice, has_espeak=1, n_speakers, sample_rate) plus tokens.txt. It runs in the `piper-tokens` post-install step and again before every voice run, so older installs are repaired. The upstream file is untouched, so verification still passes. After the fix all three cases are OK (7.4 s / 4.1 s / 4.8 s, RMS 1966 / 2962 / 1767). Also OK: a 695-character text split into 2 chunks and concatenated, speed 0.9 / 1.2, text starting with "-", typographic quotes and accents. whisper.cpp b5454 ubuntu-x64 (digest-verified) with ggml-tiny transcribed the generated Indonesian wav ("Halo semua nya, selamat datang di ...").
- **Windows equivalence**: the exe imports only onnxruntime.dll and system DLLs. Its manifest has no UTF-8 activeCodePage, so argv arrives in the ANSI code page. `ttsArgText` turns typography into ASCII everywhere and, on win32, folds text to printable ASCII. Chunks with no letter or digit are skipped. espeak-ng-data stays `<engineDir>/espeak-ng-data` (matches resources/engines/sherpa-onnx/1.13.8). The language toggle never changes the voice argv. Wine could not run the exe here (core dump), so this was not run on Windows.
- **Captions (13)**: asset mode now places pages at every Clip / audio layer using the Asset: timeline start + (source − trim) / rate, clipped to the visible window (audio: source length after trim unless looping). Sequence mode now includes non-bed audio layers (`audioPlacements`, `placePages`).
- **Thumbnail (14)**: R-135 always lists `frame-composite` (installed, no download) and uses it as the card default while the tier's image model is missing. The picker could not show it before, so it displayed an uninstalled image model while Generate stayed allowed. Thumbnail body takes `modelKey`: frame-composite never runs sd-cli, an image model must be installed (EM-7001), and no key + prompt falls back to the frame still. The frame still now uses the same asset facts / timeout / warm browser as Export stills, and a failure is EM-7101 with the Remotion message in the engine log. UI: the default is the installed tier default, then the first installed option; a not-installed model gives "Install the model first" / "Pasang modelnya dulu"; the prompt field is hidden for frame stills; ErrorBox gets `{tool}` per kind. The generic `…` fallback for err.* placeholders is done by the parallel agent in i18n/index.ts (not touched here).
- **Logging (4)**: `logEngineFailure` (generators-service) writes every engine-step failure to `engine-*.log` (`generator engine failed`: jobId, kind, engine, code, exitCode, cause exit/crash/timeout, signal, stderrTail ≤ 20 lines). The tails come from `redactEngineLines` (positional non-path args such as the spoken text become `<arg>`, lines ≤ 400 chars), and the logger then removes keys and the Windows user name.
- **Files**: packages/models/src/{install.ts, engines/sherpa.ts, engines/process.ts}; apps/service/src/s2/generators-service.ts, apps/service/src/modules/generators.ts; apps/ui/src/screens/Generate.tsx, apps/ui/src/mock/server.ts, apps/ui/src/i18n/{en,id}.json (6 keys each); docs/API_SPECIFICATION.md (§6.13), docs/LOCAL_AI_MODELS.md (§3.2 row, §4.1 layout). Tests: packages/models/test/piper.test.ts (new, 4), engines.test.ts (+4), download.test.ts (install writes sherpa-model.onnx); apps/service/test/s2/generators-qa.test.ts (new, 7); apps/ui/test/generate.test.tsx (+1).
- **Verification**: `bash scripts/run-capped.sh bash scripts/verify.sh` → exit 0: typecheck clean; Vitest pass 1 **90 files passed / 1 skipped, 868 tests passed / 1 skipped**; pass 2 (apps/ui) **24 files / 220 tests passed**; docs-check all PASS. run-capped printed "no systemd user scope; running uncapped".

## 2026-10-26 — Entry 17: cut / split at the playhead and canvas transform (move / zoom / rotate inside the frame) (ADR-028)

- **Operator request 2026-10-26 (beginners, CapCut-like)**: (A) split the selected clip / text / image / shape / audio at the playhead (scissors + S), source offsets and transitions handled, one undo; (B) reposition / scale / rotate video clips, photo clips and image overlays inside the frame with Player handles, snap guides, Inspector numeric fields, Fit / Fill / Reset and quick align.
- **Model (no schema bump, ADR-028)**: optional `Clip.transform {x, y, scale, rotation}` (x / y fractions of the frame, scale 1 = objectFit result, 0.1…10, rotation stored in [0, 360)); optional `scale` / `rotation` on OverlayImage / OverlayShape (x / y stay in `position` u). Absent = identity; `applyOps` deletes the fields again at the identity so a reset restores the earlier hash; stored v2 models parse with unchanged hashes. Caveat recorded as provisional: an older build would drop the fields silently.
- **Ops (49)**: `op:element.split {atMs}` (clip/text/image/shape/audio; second part new id, clip `trimBeforeMs + d × rate` (image 0), audio `+ d` (mod source when looping, open-ended stays open); fades split, motion stays on part 1 with exit off; transition after a clip moves to part 2; adjacent transitions re-clamped, EM-2305 warn / removed < 100 ms; keys `clip:<id>.trim` + `sequence.order` or `<kind>:<id>.timing`), `op:element.setTransform {x?, y?, scale?, rotation?}` (clip/image/shape; key `<kind>:<id>.transform`). `normaliseRotation` exported. Agent summary carries clip `transform` and overlay x / y / scale / rotation.
- **Agents**: `DesignPick.splitEdit {atMs, items}` (empty = clip at atMs; parent + one child per item; unique `list:split:…` key: never superseded, never locked) and `transformEdit {kind, id, x, y, scale, rotation}` (scalar); stash / `pickFromIntent`. SYSTEM_PROMPT **v1.2.0** (cutting + framing instructions), `prompts.generated.ts` regenerated (`node packages/agents/scripts/gen-prompts.mjs`).
- **Service / mock**: `DesignPickInput.splitEdit` / `.transformEdit` (dto.ts strict Zod, workflow.ts pass-through); mock server resolves both like the Service.
- **Engine**: `packages/engine/src/transform.ts` `clipTransformStyle` (translate px / rotate / scale on a wrapper around the media; clip frame `overflow: hidden`) and `overlayTransform` (`translate(-50%,-50%) rotate scale`), used by `ExpertmotionTimeline` for Player and render.
- **UI**: `stage/canvas-transform.ts` (pure geometry: canvas item, box, move with snap to frame centre / edges, corner scale from the opposite corner or centre, rotate with 90° snap, fit / fill / align, edit rounding, live model patch); `stage/CanvasHandles.tsx` (box + 4 corners + rotation handle + guides, Alt no snap, Esc cancels only the gesture, double-click reset, live optimistic preview, one `transformEdit` pick per gesture); Player wiring (shown only for one selected clip / image / shape playing at the playhead); `stage/TransformFields.tsx` in the Inspector (X / Y % / Scale % / Rotation °, Enter / blur apply, Esc revert, Fit / Fill / Reset, align ×5); `stage/split.ts` + Timeline scissors `stage.timeline.split` + S shortcut (one `splitEdit` pick; toasts when nothing / selection outside the playhead); intent titles. i18n: 29 keys added per locale (targeted line insertions).
- **Docs**: DECISIONS ADR-028; DATABASE_SCHEMA §4.2 (ClipTransform, overlay scale / rotation), §4.3 transform render rule, §4.5 optional-field policy, §5.2 row; AI_WORKFLOW §4 (split / transform rows + Compile), §5 (2 rows), §6 re-clamp row; FRD FR-179, FR-180 (+ group map, trace, coverage); EDITOR_INTERACTION_MODEL IX-27, IX-28, §7 (S, Shift, Alt, Esc), §8; ELEMENT_IDS `stage.player.canvas.layer/.box/.handle/.guide`, `stage.timeline.split`, `stage.timeline.inspector.transform.*`; UI_UX_SPECIFICATION Player / Timeline / Inspector rows; API_SPECIFICATION R-060 body; GOLDEN_SCENARIOS GS-22; SYSTEM_PROMPT changelog; memory.md ADR-028 row.

## 2026-10-26 — Entry 16: CapCut-style layered timeline — layers, drag / trim / lane change for every item (ADR-027)

- **Operator decision 2026-10-25**: (a) layered tracks, top row = front-most layer, texts / images / shapes stack and overlap in time on their own lanes (a text can be above or below an image); (b) every Timeline item can be moved, trimmed at both edges and moved between lanes, with snapping to the playhead and other edges (Alt/Option disables), each edit undoable like other picks.
- **Model (schema v2)**: `layer` (int ≥ 0, higher = front) on TextLayer / OverlayImage / OverlayShape, `lane` on AudioLayer; `CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION = 2`, `MIGRATIONS[1] = assignLanesV1` (v1 render order kept: each item gets the lowest layer above every earlier overlapping item; audio first-fit lanes; `durationMs` dropped from v1 looping layers because v2 honours it). New `packages/composition-model/src/layers.ts` (lane rule, `visualStack`, `topmostAt`, `normalizeLanes`, `laneConflicts`). Lane rule in `applyOps`: new item in front of what it overlaps (0 if nothing; audio first free lane); a move / trim / explicit lane onto a busy lane goes to the lane above, else a new lane inserted there; lanes renumbered densely after every op. CM-012 (warn) for overlaps on a lane in hand-made JSON. Looping audio with `durationMs` now stops there (timing.ts + Engine).
- **Ops (47)**: `op:element.setTiming {atMs, durationMs, trimBeforeMs? (audio), layer?}` (text/image/shape/audio; one op per drag gesture), `op:element.setLayer {layer} | {move: up|down|front|back}` (audio: lane / up / down only); optional `layer` on `op:text.add`, `op:shape.add`, `op:overlay.addImage`; `op:text.setTiming` kept (same key, lane rule). Locking keys `<kind>:<id>.timing` (+ `.layer`), `<kind>:<id>.layer`.
- **Engine**: texts and overlays rendered merged in `visualStack` order (DOM order = stacking), captions on top, video below; same component for Player and render.
- **Agents**: `DesignPick.elementEdit` compiled to the new ops (category text/shape/audio/asset, Compile path, no LLM); `elementsAt` picks the front-most text; `summarizeForAgent` sends `layer`, overlay `durationMs`/asset, audio `durationMs`/`lane`. SYSTEM_PROMPT **v1.1.0** (P-2 layers/stacking instruction), `prompts.generated.ts` regenerated with `node packages/agents/scripts/gen-prompts.mjs`.
- **Service / mock**: `DesignPickInput.elementEdit` (dto.ts, workflow.ts), mock server resolution + `__elementEdit` stash; checkpoints verify against the stored JSON hash when the file predates a schema migration (otherwise every v1 checkpoint would read as damaged after migration).
- **Timeline UI** (`apps/ui/src/stage/Timeline.tsx`): rows captions · new-layer lane · layers front → back · video · audio lanes · new audio lane (`laneRows`); drag any text/image/shape/audio bar in time and across lanes (36 px per row), edge handles trim (audio left edge moves `trimBeforeMs`, clamped to the source), snapping to playhead + other edges within 8 px else frame grid, Alt disables, Esc cancels, live ghost + snap guide, dimmed source bar; keyboard ←/→ frame, Shift ±1 s, Alt+↑/↓ lane (focus kept after the lane change; global shortcuts skip a focused editable bar); one `actions.elementEdit` pick per gesture; inspector shows Layer / Audio lane; image overlays are `data-kind="image"`. Pure `elementDragEdit` / `laneRows` exported for tests.
- **i18n**: 29 keys added, 6 removed per locale (targeted line edits; `ui.stage.timeline.track.overlay/.text/.audio`, `a11y.stage.timeline.track.overlay/.text/.audio`).
- **Docs**: DECISIONS ADR-027; DATABASE_SCHEMA §4.1/4.2/4.3 (render order, lane rule), §4.4 CM-012, §5.2 schema-version table, §9 example; AI_WORKFLOW §4 (element edit + Compile row), §5 (2 rows + layer args), §6 conflict row; FRD FR-063, FR-064, FR-068 (+ FR-029, trace rows); EDITOR_INTERACTION_MODEL IX-26, §6, §7 shortcuts, §8 drag rules; ELEMENT_IDS (`stage.timeline.lane.layer/.audio/.new`, `.element.handle`, `.ghost`, `.snap`; retired `track.overlay/.text/.audio`); UI_UX_SPECIFICATION Timeline rows; API_SPECIFICATION R-060 body; GOLDEN_SCENARIOS GS-21; USER_FLOWS id refs. Glossary not changed (frozen; "layer"/"lane" are defined in ADR-027).

## 2026-10-24 — Entry 6b: AI prompts encrypted in release builds

- `npm run build:release -w @expertmotion/service` stubs `prompts.generated` with empty strings, writes `dist/assets.enc` (AES-256-GCM of the prompt set) and `dist/prompt-half-b.hex`; half A is a build constant in `service.cjs`, half B a build constant in `main.cjs` sent in the bootstrap message (`promptKeyHalf`); key = sha256(A xor B) (`apps/service/src/services/prompt-assets.ts`, same derivation as `apps/desktop/src/lib/keysplit.ts`). The service decrypts before boot and installs the set (`installPromptSet` in `packages/agents/src/prompt-store.ts`); a missing or altered file or half fails with EM-8007. `harden` verifies no prompt text remains in `service.cjs`, `main.cjs` carries this build's half B, and `assets.enc` is in the signed integrity manifest. `release:win` and `cross-build-win.sh` run the release service build. Development builds are unchanged (prompts bundled).
- Verified: 615 tests passed (5 new), typecheck clean; the built `assets.enc` decrypts with the half A found in `service.cjs` plus half B, and `service.cjs` contains no prompt text. Honest limit: both halves are on the user's machine (as bytecode in the Windows build), so a determined owner can still recover the prompts; this raises the cost, it does not prevent it.

- **Findings and doc changes made** (same commit): SEC-011 refined (lock applies to wrong-token requests only; valid tokens never limited; missing tokens not counted; reason: a web page cannot send a wrong `Authorization` header without a preflight, but it can send 21 token-less requests and would otherwise lock the Editor out); NFR-020 amended (autosave is a debounce: 2 s after last edit, ≤ 5 s while dirty, plus before Execute/render; a fixed 10 s timer only meets the 10 s limit at its boundary); `docs/POC_PLAN.md` §4 result log filled.
